head: a8002e6
summary:
Delivered the ordinary in-process .NET 10 channel gateway with official MCP SDK 1.0.0, all production capability bridges, eight real prepare/commit pairs, trusted person/conversation ledger, checked composition, safe narration audit and owner-authorized single-use downloads.
Strict build and format pass; 1,114 fast tests and four diagnostic tests pass.
All 255 gateway and 1,514 API replay exchanges ran on ordinary executables.
Gateway raw: 528 fields and 0/255 cases because every exchange differs at Vary; separate policy diagnostic: 233/255, 11 fully waived cases, 56 unresolved fields in 22 cases, no numerical waiver.
API: 2,325 raw fields, identical ordered differences across two post-change executions; no new external-conductor parity claim.
All stages implemented; infrastructure, privacy-policy and cross-replica limitations remain explicit. Head identifies the tested implementation commit; the following documentation commit records this status. Local commits only, clean tree, no live systems.

deviations.what: The official SDK executes MCP through a thin bounded channel transport rather than its default HTTP endpoint mapping.
deviations.why: The channel owns origin/authentication order, person-bound sessions and its existing JSON/error contract. Actual official server/client interoperability and every catalogue schema are tested without forking the SDK.

deviations.what: Two recorded non-writer Cowork fixed-tool calls are refused once person-derived results carry the intended lane markers.
deviations.why: Keep the existing application's fail-closed privacy design instead of leaking cohorts or finding evidence. The authorization-preservation policy tension is an owner decision; missing facts and refusal differences remain unresolved on the diagnostic.

deviations.what: The governed catalogue lists eight available datasets, with an explicit note for three unavailable infrastructure datasets.
deviations.why: No fabricated availability or successful empty aggregate is introduced. The count/list differences and inherited governed refusal-code/field differences remain unwaived.

deviations.what: Narration audit persists safe verdict/count codes and content hashes, not submitted prose summaries.
deviations.why: Rejected prose can contain identifiers or hostile content and must not be copied into an audit/log payload merely because the caller supplied a summary.

findings: The official SDK truthfully advertises logging; its extra capability is registered as a framework default, not removed to imitate Python.
Source fixed-tool risk/findings envelopes omit person-only markers although their facts can identify individual employees.

Python claim previews allocate new IDs for rows that are never stored. Pure .NET previews do not allocate production identities, so later real confirmation/correlation/artifact IDs differ; no dummy draws or identifier waivers were added.
The source's rendered True boolean is displayed as JSON true; the typed preview and all figures are unchanged.
The channel must not inherit the portal's optional local writer mode or anonymous contract-reset mode; entitlement applies to previews and commits.
Verified write-envelope failures previously bypassed application audit. REST and recognizable MCP pre-dispatch write refusals now have one safe refusal audit.
Unknown download ticket 502 invalid_arguments and replayed ticket 410 confirmation_replayed are intentional F-19/F-20 behavior, not normalized to other statuses.
All raw gateway cases include Vary differences. Raw failure counts and separately applied policy counts are distinct evidence, not interchangeable passing-test totals.

needs_human.item: Reconcile source fixed-tool person-lane omissions with the valid-request authorization-preservation policy.
needs_human.why: The documented privacy lane refuses unentitled Cowork access, while two recordings returned unmarked person-derived risk/findings facts. The safer lane check is retained and the missing results remain visible, not numerically waived.

needs_human.item: Prove atomic idempotency-key reservation across replicas for different confirmations.
needs_human.why: Host-local key leases and atomic same-confirmation consume prevent tested races. The existing persistence port does not guarantee global different-confirmation key exclusivity across gateway processes.

needs_human.item: M-01 ingestion overrides of year-resolved wage basis, measuring date and pay codes.
needs_human.why: Inherited behavior conflicts with year-pack precedence but changes figures; preserved exactly for owner reconciliation.

needs_human.item: First-program credit_math pricing in states with multiple programs.
needs_human.why: Inherited Python pricing is figure-sensitive. The gateway reuses it and adds no new credit_math refusal.
Row count plus maximum modified timestamp is not a Delta snapshot and cannot detect count/max-preserving edits.

needs_human.item: Complete/prove unavailable governed datasets and native privacy suppression/distinct support.
needs_human.why: The typed infrastructure port has not proved atomic hidden-person suppression or safe cross-year person identity. Dataset availability and refusal-code/field differences remain explicit.
Native monetary AVG, zero-worksite SQL/projector semantics, partial strict leap-day fiscal handling and live artifact publication are not proved by hermetic gateway tests.

needs_human.item: Inherited replay storage, identity and provenance differences.
needs_human.why: Money-string scale, later genuine IDs, valid long-text storage, provenance and stored-program values remain documented W2 boundaries; no changed tool figures or such values were waived to claim gateway parity.
No live Fabric, Foundry, Entra or customer access was approved or attempted. Real deployment grants, native concurrency and byte publication require an authorized environment.
